title: Monotone compact exhaustion of an open subset of ℝⁿ that absorbs every compact subset (step 1 of the diagonal extraction)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ and every open set U ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) there are sets Q_j ⊆ ℝⁿ (j ∈ ℕ) such that: every Q_j is compact; Q_j ⊆ U for every j; Q_i ⊆ Q_j whenever i ≤ j (Q is monotone); and every compact set K ⊆ U is contained in some Q_j.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ∃ Q : ℕ → Set (Rn n), (∀ j, IsCompact (Q j)) ∧ (∀ j, Q j ⊆ U) ∧ Monotone Q ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ j, K ⊆ Q j
